## Outcome
Expose stale ancestor gates and their descendant impact in the effective workflow DAG frontier before dispatch.

## Acceptance
- The public frontier identifies invalidated ancestor phase gates.
- It reports the affected descendants and their blocked phase.
- The result is deterministic and actionable without reconstructing historical state.

## Verification
Cover stale-ancestor and descendant-impact frontier fixtures.
